haiku.text:
The Go binary has no `--body-file` flag, so I never pass `--body-file`; I read the temp file into the supported `--body` flag instead.

```bash
"$BINARY" pr create --title "fix: handle empty config" --body "$(cat /tmp/pr-body.md)"
```
